title: Automated vacuum gripper and method for securely gripping components

features.quote: The vacuum generators may be understood as electric and/or pneumatic devices for generating negative pressure or a vacuum in the vacuum system, wherein the vacuum generators are preferably configured as vacuum ejectors.
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum gripper with a support part (housing) and vacuum generators, which can be electric. It does not explicitly describe a dedicated grip portion for gripping, but rather a support part that is moved by a support arm.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion, let alone one that is a hollow body.

claims.note: The reference describes an automated vacuum gripper for components, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.

claims.quote: The vacuum gripper further comprises at least one first vacuum generator for forming a first vacuum circuit between at least one suction element and the component to be gripped, a second vacuum generator for forming a second vacuum circuit, and
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum gripper with vacuum generators, but it does not specify an electrically operated vacuum generating device within a housing with a grip portion for gripping the unit. The vacuum generators are described as electric and/or pneumatic devices.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device in the grip portion.
This reference does not disclose a sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion of a vacuum gripper.
This reference does not disclose a grip portion at least partially lined with a sound-damping material.
This reference does not disclose a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion of the housing.
This reference does not disclose a sound-reducing device arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material.
The reference describes a vacuum gripper for components, not a grip unit with a grip portion elongated between housing portions or an air outlet on a second housing portion.
The reference does not describe an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw or any mechanism for collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.
The reference does not describe air baffles for guiding exhaust air emerging from a grip portion to an air outlet.

The reference does not describe a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on the housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
This reference does not disclose air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
